name: Shay's Bell
summary: Shay’s Bell is a cherished bell kept in a chest in Feralas. Shay Leafrunner says its sound can call her back when she wanders.

sections.title: A Familiar Sound
sections.body: Shay Leafrunner keeps her bell in a chest in Feralas. She loves its sound and says it will bring her running back when she wanders away. Rockbiter is waiting for Shay at his camp, and the bell is meant to help guide her home.

faq.answer: Shay says the bell’s sound will get her attention and bring her back if she wanders off.

faq.q: Where can I find Shay’s Bell?
faq.answer: Shay’s Bell is kept in Shay’s Chest in Feralas.

faq.q: Who does the bell belong to?
faq.answer: The bell is precious to Shay Leafrunner, who loves its sound.

faq.q: Who is Shay trying to find?
faq.answer: Shay Leafrunner is trying to find her friend Rockbiter, who is at his camp.
